Specification: This module defines helper operators for converting TLA+ values into JSON-like string representations and for modeling JSON serialization and deserialization interfaces. It recursively builds JSON object strings from functions or records over a finite domain, JSON array strings from sequence-like or finite-set values, and chooses between object and array formatting based on simple structural tests. The file does not model a transition system or fault-tolerant algorithm; instead, it provides pure value-level operators, including stubbed serialization operators that return TRUE and nondeterministic deserialization operators defined with CHOOSE.
IfThenElse: IF D = DOMAIN F THEN "{" \o ToJsonKeyValue(F, d) \o IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "}" ELSE ToJsonObjectString(F, D \ {d}) ELSE ", " \o ToJsonKeyValue(F, d) \o IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "}" ELSE ToJsonObjectString(F, D \ {d})
IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "}" ELSE ToJsonObjectString(F, D \ {d})
IF D = DOMAIN F THEN "[" \o ToString(F[d]) \o IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "]" ELSE ToJsonArrayString(F, D \ {d}) ELSE ", " \o ToString(F[d]) \o IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "]" ELSE ToJsonArrayString(F, D \ {d})
IF D \ {d} = {} THEN "]" ELSE ToJsonArrayString(F, D \ {d})
IF IsFiniteSet(F) \/ IsSequence(F, D) THEN ToJsonArrayString(F, D) ELSE ToJsonObjectString(F, D)
IF DOMAIN value = {} THEN "{}" ELSE ToJsonString(value, DOMAIN value)
IF DOMAIN value = {} THEN "[]" ELSE ToJsonArrayString(value, DOMAIN value)
IF DOMAIN value = {} THEN "{}" ELSE ToJsonObjectString(value, DOMAIN value)
